title: Saved CA head + F1s′ Bangla fuser refit (NOREL) -> f1s_eval.zip, fuser JSON, trCA
role: No head training: scores the saved CA head (ct01r2_final_models.pt of datasets/ngnnguynchn/flag2027-evalu-f1s-p; 10 projectors; face [farl16 || clipC5], voice CAT4 = [sam100p || sam100f || rn293 || ecapa1024]) -> stream trCA on the four lists (z constants from the v4 train rows; level-0 0.0), then refits the F1s′ Bangla fuser (logistic regression C = 1.0 on [Z, C, Z x C]; Z = XALL_deep0, XALL_cca, XALL_ib, XALL_age, anP512_deep, anP512_cca, trCA; C = is_en, pf_m, pv_m, gdiff, agef, agev, agegap; 37 070 SAFE-04 out-of-fold trials; NOREL) and writes e2e_out/submission_cleantune01_F1_CA_eval.zip (= f1s_eval.zip: Bangla = -logit F1s′, English bytes copied from F0s), cleantune01_fuser_bangla_CA.json and ct01r2_final_eval.npz. Bangla of 13.54 uses -logit F1s′; English uses the fuser JSON + trCA (a_factor).

WP-A runner: this stage has runner_requirements.literal_kaggle_input = true and kaggle_strict = true. Off Kaggle the runner points the literal /kaggle/input at the stage's virtual input (Linux symlink, Docker mount, or FF_LITERAL_KAGGLE=mounted); on Kaggle it cannot, and today it only warns unless FF_LITERAL_STRICT=1. Requested: honour kaggle_strict (refuse the stage on Kaggle when /kaggle/input holds attachments that are not inputs of the stage, unless FF_LITERAL_KAGGLE=mounted), i.e. strict by default for these stages. Until then set FF_LITERAL_STRICT=1, or run e50cc / e112f0sx / e112f1sx on Linux / Docker or in a dedicated Kaggle session with exactly the inputs of the stage attached (as the original runs).

runner_requirements.why: The lab modules decoded from CODE_B64 (Experiment/CLEANTUNE-01/run.py _find / _find_all, FACELORA-03/run.py adir, SCALE-CC-01/run.py vox2b_dir, T3ENC-01/run.py strict_drop, VOICELORA-01 lookups) locate voice_rn293 / voice_ecapa1024 (e47rs), face_clipB3 / face_clipC5 (e65xbs, e65xcs), vb/voice_samS4.npy (tap01), vb/voice_rn293.npy (aux voices), feats_vox2b, lid_strict.json, the F0 zip and ct01r2_final_eval.npz by scanning the literal path /kaggle/input (env overrides exist only for some: CT_DIRS, FL3_DIRS). Code decoded at run time from a base64 zip is written to disk and imported; the runner's replacement of the string '/kaggle/input' in the stage code does not reach it. The literal path /kaggle/input must therefore show exactly this stage's inputs while the stage runs: e.g. a container with the virtual input mounted at /kaggle/input (as release/docker/ff.py does), or a symlink /kaggle/input -> the virtual input on a Linux host without /kaggle. In a Kaggle notebook whose own /kaggle/input holds other attachments, run this stage in a session with exactly its inputs attached (as the original run). /kaggle/input must also hold no second copy of these files (e.g. flag2027-feats-screen2-p or the adapter datasets, whose list arrays are those of the dev split): the notebook asserts one folder each for face_clip*_train.npy and voice_rn293_train.npy, but the modules take the first hit of their own scan.
runner_requirements.kaggle: separate session with exactly these inputs
